reason: Official final wind-down of hosted operations; retired hosted product and support is not admitted even where immutable contracts continue and direct withdrawals remain possible.

lifecycleEvidence.quote: Important announcement: Sadly, we’re announcing that Hats.finance is entering a final wind-down of its hosted operations. After a lot of reflection, we’ve reached the point where keeping a centralized UI and servers running is no longer sustainable
lifecycleEvidence.additionalIndexedQuote: The Hats.finance hosted frontend and backend (UI and servers) are expected to go offline on Dec 31, 2025.
lifecycleEvidence.retrievalLimit: Direct X fetch unavailable because automated X access requires xAI credentials; indexed official post and corroborating coverage retained without representing the full post as fetched.

lifecycleEvidence.quote: The team believes that continuing to operate a centralized user interface (UI) and server is no longer sustainable, and there are currently no plans to adopt a new legal or operational framework to maintain this custodial architecture.
lifecycleEvidence.contractCaveat: The Hats protocol will remain deployed on-chain and managed by the DAO, with the core contracts intended to continue running as coded.
lifecycleEvidence.withdrawalQuote: Users can submit withdrawal requests through the custodial UI before December 17; after that, withdrawals must be completed by interacting directly with the contract.

primaryDeploymentReference.description: Legacy official HATVaults reference, not activated and not asserted to be current product. Full implementation inventory intentionally not pursued after lifecycle rejection.

limitations: No assertion that immutable contracts cease functioning or funds are inaccessible.
The rejection is based on explicit final wind-down, not failed app fetch, low deposits, old code or financial safety research.
No capability admission or exit-only exception.
